lost.narrative: Runoff due to heavy rain from thunderstorms caused an un-named creek to overflow its banks and cause flooding across Elkin Highway in North Wilkesboro.
A trained spotter reported part of Missionary Ridge Road near Bon Aqua was washed out due to flooding.
TSpotter Twitter reports indicated McEwen Drive at Carothers Parkway in Franklin was flooded and impassable.
